**A tab click in the pinned drawer brings its panel into view (#1326)**

After #1307 pinned the drawer with tabs in a fixed head, renderDrawer rebuilt .drawer-body and reset scrollTop to 0, so on an epic a tab click showed the children list, not the panel. Fix: renderDrawer/buildDrawer split; a tab click sets tabScrollPending and scrolls the body by offset arithmetic (not scrollIntoView, so the page stays put); same-node re-renders keep scrollTop; a new node starts at 0. The browser clamps scrollTop, so the panel gets min-height of one body height after a tab click (D122). The head tab rule became .drawer .drawer-head .tabs to beat later .drawer .tabs. Process lesson: #1323 was merged at its round-1 head before the requested fix landed, so the fix shipped as a follow-up PR — say 'do not merge yet' explicitly when a fix round is pending.
